data.name: Myriad Mayhem
data.detailed_description:
Retro Hero Siege Revived

Born from the golden age of Warcraft & Starcraft custom maps, Myriad Mayhem brings back the frantic, ability-driven chaos of classic hero-sieges — refined for a modern roguelite era.

A Relentless Myriad of Enemies

You are under siege. Reinforce your defences, grow stronger, then retaliate — drive the enemy from the map entirely

before they overwhelm you.

Conquer, Then Build

Expand your kingdom by claiming new lands. Fortify the frontier with towers and barracks — or turn a well-protected region into a thriving settlement to fuel your campaign.

Spoils of War

On your conquests, fortune may reward you with new gear — expanding your arsenal and letting you further specialize your playstyle between runs.

No Two Runs Alike

Each ability comes with its own talent-tree that fundamentally transforms how it plays — a Firebolt can be shaped to explode on impact, gain a scalding burn, or embed a volatile core that detonates on death. Equip your gear, choose your abilities, and shape them into something entirely your own.

Meta Progression

Earn progression points as you rank up and invest them in permanent upgrades — bolstering your strength and tilting the odds in your favor.

AI usage in game

This game uses AI to help with localization (translations) from English to most other languages — in its current version.

data.short_description: Myriad Mayhem is a challenging Hero Siege game with roguelite and base-building mechanics. Forge builds from equipment and abilities — each with exclusive talent-trees — and grow powerful enough to withstand the neverending onslaught trying to raze your kingdom to the ground.
